Summary: Temporal retrieval coverage transparency: the brief does not show the retrieval basis behind NEW and DISSOLVED
Description: 1) Original intent: the guest can tell a completed search that found no qualifying filing from an incomplete search (rubric item 1: 'no change observed' vs 'not checked in this window'; KRYL-1386 spec v1.1 section 4 honest coverage record). Observed 2026-10-10 on build 23b47c8 (localhost, Broadcom): Vanguard Capital Management NEW shows only the rule code 'coverage-complete' and 'as of 2025-10-10: no filing'; the retrieval record that justified it is stored but never rendered. 2) Acceptance criteria: (a) under each NEW and DISSOLVED classification the brief renders the stored retrieval basis of the browser run: search window, form families, filings and documents read, requests and failures; (b) values come from the stored result of that browser run (relationshipchangeservice _results retrieval coverage), not from the Node acceptance trace; (c) a completed search with no qualifying filing and an incomplete search are worded differently; (d) the coverage boundary is stated: completeness applies to the name-narrowed SEC search and is not proof that no other filing exists; (e) no new classification logic and no change to the thresholds or rules of KRYL-1386; (f) a render test covers complete coverage, failed window, failed document and at-cap cases; report-surface text follows the section 7 font contract. 3) Current implementation state: retrieveOwnershipObservations returns coverage (windows, failedWindows, failedDocs, reasons, request counts) and runRelationshipChange stores it in _results as retrieval; relationshipchangeblock.jsx renders only an incomplete-coverage statement via temporalStatement and the rule codes; the complete case shows nothing of the basis. 4) Dependencies: relationshipchangeservice.js, relationshipchangeblock.jsx, relationshipchangetext.js, KRYL-1386 (Review); the stored record is in browser memory only (not persisted), so the display is per page session; KRYL-1389 will govern snapshot capture later. 5) Superseded by a newer ticket: no. 6) Maps to the current product model: yes (source-dated temporal change, Absence-Is-Signal, rubric item 1). Status: filed 2026-10-10 from the Broadcom review; no code changed.
